note: P3 decay screen of fresh self-verifying leads (mine_test_candidates.py). Verdict is from `lazarus decay-check --sandbox docker` at the repo's default-branch HEAD, which is a FIRST-PASS proxy: the frozen task will clone the pinned pre-cutoff SHA, which is at least as dead as HEAD. A DECAYED verdict here means the repo needs reviving (good); an ALIVE verdict needs the pinned commit re-checked before the repo is dropped. stage_reason distinguishes an install-time break (deep dependency rot) from an example-time break (which can be shallow and needs per-task vetting of whether the revival is a real challenge). This is a screening record, not a task.
